$comment: Screen registry for the iOS PR screenshots job (.github/workflows/ios-screenshots.yml). Each screen is a deterministic, leaderless app state reached purely through UITestHooks launch arguments (DEBUG builds only — see App/UITestHooks.swift), so capture needs no taps and no leader. Every screen runs on every ios-app PR: unlike Storybook there is no per-story diff mapping — the app is one connected surface and the whole set costs under two simulator-minutes. Add a screen when you add a hook; names are kebab-case and become the screenshot filenames (ios-<name>.png). Dedup note: the capture pins the simulator status bar so static screens hash stably across runs; screens showing iOS 26 glass chrome (sheet Done buttons) or live animations render nondeterministically and re-upload on every push — expected, not a bug.
